name: Residence Permit for Students

requirements.blocker_text: Requires full-time enrolment in Iceland, defined as 30 ECTS credits per semester, confirmed by the educational institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission and confirm full-time (30 ECTS/semester) enrolment.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum secure financial support of ISK 259,951/month (individual), ISK 415,922 for a couple, plus ISK 129,976 per additional dependent family member aged 18+, covering the entire permit validity period.

Health insurance valid in Iceland for at least 3 months from registration of legal domicile, minimum coverage ISK 2,000,000; national insurance applies automatically after 3 months of registered residence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of sufficient funds for the permit's full duration

outcome.duration_length: determined case-by-case, matched to the study program and financial support demonstrated

sources.title: Island.is -- Residence Permit for Students: Requirements: 30 ECTS/semester full-time enrolment, ISK 259,951/month financial-means floor, health insurance

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iceland). pr_after_months (48) reflects that former students on an eligible permit can reach permanent residence in 2 years after graduation IF the total including prior study reaches 4 years (per is_permanent_residence.json's exceptions) -- modeled here as the general 4-year baseline rather than assuming the faster former-student track applies automatically. family_can_join modeled false: no student-specific family reunification provision was located in this pass.
